//: Self-contained config for emitting consumer-facing type declarations (dist/). Runs via `build:dts` before npm publish (see scripts/publish-shared-libs.js); not used by Nx builds inside the monorepo (those resolve src/ via tsconfig paths). Emit is intentionally tolerant: declaration files are emitted even if type errors are reported, because consumers compile against these declarations with skipLibCheck. The publish script verifies dist/index.d.ts exists after this runs.
